- SDR: signal identification in the spectrum. Put the marker on a signal: its width is measured and the app suggests what it probably is, among 61 kinds of transmissions (FM, airband, AIS, Meshtastic, LoRaWAN, mobile antennas, 5G, TETRA, FT8…), with a confidence and a button to the tool that decodes it
- Wi-Fi scanner: the best channel for your box on 2.4 and 5 GHz, from the networks heard around, compared with the channel you are on now (your own access points left out, DFS channels flagged)
- Wi-Fi: a new Wi-Fi distance (RTT) tool, the distance to compatible access points (802.11mc) to a metre or two, without connecting, with its spread, whether you are getting closer, and a calibration
- Mobile network: a new drive test tool, the signal recorded along a trip (with the screen off too), drawn on a map in the colour of its quality, with the share of the route by quality and by network, and export to KML (Google Earth) and CSV
